description: This file defines multiple React functional components related to displaying DID (Decentralized Identifier) status badges, count badges, identity badges, and composite status components. It imports types and UI components, and exports functionality mainly for rendering visual indicators of DID states in a web UI.

methods.name: DIDStatusBadge
methods.description: Displays a badge indicating the status of a DID such as active, inactive, revoked, or unknown, with configurable icon display and size.

methods.name: DIDCountBadge
methods.description: Displays a badge showing the count of reasoners or skills, with relevant icon and styling.

methods.name: DIDIdentityBadge
methods.description: Displays a badge with a formatted DID and an optional copy-to-clipboard button.

methods.name: CompositeDIDStatus
methods.description: Combines status badge, reasoner count, skill count, and optional DID identity into a composite component, with compact and full modes.
